attempts.summary: Configured centralized syslog forwarding from node2 (inventory app, identified by [REDACTED] programname "inventory") to node1 using Ansible run from the control node (node3). node1 runs rsyslog with imudp/imtcp listeners on port 514 bound to a dedicated ruleset that writes matching messages to /var/log/inventory/node2.log; node2 forwards messages tagged "inventory" to node1:514/tcp via a disk-assisted omfwd queue for resiliency. rsyslog is enabled+started on both nodes so the pipeline survives reboots. Verified log delivery before and after restarting node2, node1, and node3 (control node) one at a time, confirming boot-id changes and full recovery of the flow after each restart.
